lines: at the edge of the warped horizon
if I pass through those clouds
the crack I trace with my finger
I could even touch the end of the rainbow we saw that day
in the dull‑colored sky that fills
under the overpass after the rain
even in the days that repeat
in the empty void I have always sought your shadow
within the hole opened in my heart
the brilliance of the summer day we met
in this world I can touch with my eyes and hands
the sound of a heartbeat sleeping deep in my chest
the season that sang of indigo
like you on the other side of the mirror
I could even touch the end of the rainbow we saw that day
